# Google Sheets

The Google Sheets category has 8 tasks. Each entry shows the task's latest revision, the one the palette adds. See [Reading an entry](./overview#reading-an-entry).

## Add Sheet

Add new sheet to a Google spreadsheet.

- **Slug:** `add-sheet`
- **Type:** `template`
- **Revision:** 4
- **Image:** Default task image.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Service Account Key | `serviceAccountKey` | Secured | No | `$(workspace.params.google-service-account-key)` | The service account's whole JSON key file, pasted as-is. Replaces Client Email and Private Key |
| Private Key | `privateKey` | Secured | No |  | The service account's private key. Not needed when Service Account Key is set |
| Client Email | `clientEmail` | Text | No |  | The service account's client email. Not needed when Service Account Key is set |
| Spreadsheet ID | `spreadsheetId` | Text | Yes |  | The ID of the desired spreadsheet |
| Sheet Title | `title` | Text | Yes |  | The title of the new sheet |

No results.

## Append Data

Append data to an existing Google spreadsheet.
The supported range notations are A1 notation and R1C1 notation.

- **Slug:** `append-data`
- **Type:** `template`
- **Revision:** 4
- **Image:** Default task image.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Service Account Key | `serviceAccountKey` | Secured | No | `$(workspace.params.google-service-account-key)` | The service account's whole JSON key file, pasted as-is. Replaces Client Email and Private Key |
| Private Key | `privateKey` | Secured | No |  | The service account's private key. Not needed when Service Account Key is set |
| Client Email | `clientEmail` | Text | No |  | The service account's client email. Not needed when Service Account Key is set |
| Spreadsheet ID | `spreadsheetId` | Text | Yes |  | The ID of the desired spreadsheet |
| Data Range | `range` | Text | Yes |  | The desired data range |
| Cell Data | `values` | Text Area | Yes |  | Input data |

**Results**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `response` | Append information |
